title: Shared enclave rootfs exceeds the host verification storage ceiling
symptoms: Cloud Hypervisor enclave stops before rootfs-digest and rootfs-attestation
conditions: The shared rootfs copy allocates more than the older 2 GiB host verification domain
The explicit rootfs-copy check reports ENOSPC; generic rsync failure or logical file size alone is insufficient
rootCause: The shared toolchain rootfs required about 2.44 GiB of allocated copy storage, exceeding the previous 2 GiB host-only verification ceiling before digest or attestation could run.

probe.expect: Find failed bounded-artifacts/rootfs-copy with ENOSPC and later not-attempted checks; read bounded-cleanup separately. EACCES, EIO or an absent copy check does not establish capacity exhaustion.

action: Use source with the 4 GiB host verification/image-staging ceiling and per-role temporary-copy release, keeping guest writable limits, immutable artifacts, digest/attestation checks and cleanup guards unchanged. Preserve startup and cleanup evidence even when verification fails; do not infer a fixed release tag.
